items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: music for Noble Sissle when he came to town

ctx.x: music for Noble Sissle when he came to town and the Duncan Sisters when they were showing out in Hollywood, and, oh, we opened up a business of doing music for people all over the United States. We carried big ads in the papers, and we got sometimes do ten, twelve, fifteen songs a week. They send in the word...the words, we put music to it; they send the music, we put words to it, or they had an idea, we'd...just a bunch of words--we'd make a song out of it and make a record and send it to them, you know, and we…
